description: Eight-rung selectivity ladder for dbpedia-abstract, picked from dbpedia-abstract-contains-s42 to be even in log-selectivity (94.49% down to 0.00060%). Truth embedded per-query; binding via dataset checksum only. Extended with a second eight-rung ladder of curated abstract phrases (0.085 down to 0.0011): entity and boilerplate literals a real filter would use, with needle lengths 6-36.
